verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a UI framework's ecosystem, so the axis applies. The pack shows no official React CLI: the docs point users to third-party build tools (vite, parcel, rsbuild) and frameworks (Next.js, React Router). The React Compiler is a Babel plugin and the hooks tooling is an ESLint plugin, neither a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
